signals.summary: A steady, multi-source push toward daily mobility work and functional bodyweight strength framed around aging well and 'future-proofing' the body, rather than aesthetics.
signals.why_now: Independent outlets converge on the theme: Tom's Guide on 5 bodyweight moves for senior functional strength (45h), NYT 'exercises physical therapists wish everyone did' (62h), a resistance-band mobility segment (WBAL, 60h), SELF's '14 mobility moves for over-35s', and Joe Wicks' morning mobility routine. Evergreen but continuously refreshed across many sources.

signals.summary: A wave around curated evening wind-down routines and calming bedroom environments — predictable last hour, dim light, screen-free rituals, and natural sleep helpers like tart-cherry juice — as a mindful recovery practice.
signals.why_now: High recent volume across independent sources: a widely-shared take that making the last hour predictable transformed sleep (8h), news on morning sunlight tied to earlier sleep schedules (7h), tart-cherry-juice + chia soaking for sleep (Verywell, 62h), and repeated melatonin-vs-magnesium coverage. The ritual/environment angle (not medical claims) is what carries.

signals.summary: Hyrox, the standardized functional-fitness race (running intervals plus sled push, wall balls, rowing, ski-erg), keeps spreading worldwide and across age groups, becoming the marquee community-fitness format of the moment.
signals.why_now: Fresh independent coverage: DW on Hyrox as a global craze (19h) and The Times on Chinese pensioners taking it up (41h), sitting atop a long evergreen tail (Yahoo, USA Today comparing it to CrossFit). A durable, growing format rather than one viral post.

signals.topic: VO2 max & exercise intensity for longevity
signals.summary: Interest is building around 'VO2 maxxing' and short bursts of higher-intensity effort as a longevity lever, backed by fresh science on how exercise intensity drives whole-body benefits.
signals.why_now: Times of India on 'VO2 maxxing' as a live fitness trend (27h) lands alongside a heavily-upvoted Cell Reports Medicine paper on exercise intensity and interorgan communication (HN, 47h) and Newsweek's '3-minute exercise beats 90-minute workouts'. Converging but narrower and more body/performance-dependent.
